title: System Redundancy
hook: One frozen payment account can shut you down overnight. It happens.
statement: Every critical system needs a plan B.
explainer: Lose your main client, platform, or processor with no backup. Revenue stops.
sop: List every system you can't run without.
Count which ones have a real backup.
Build and test one this month.
equation_example: Backup Systems 2 ÷ Critical Systems 5 = 40%. Three things could stop you cold.
question: Write down your biggest single point of failure.
closing_statement: One system is one failure from zero.
